findings.description: The R translation gives different district fixed effects sample size, selected coefficients and reported p values from the article.
findings.evidence: Table 1 district model: R n=187 (paper n=186); agriculture committee coefficient -38.72 (paper -36.3); contribution coefficient -0.000631 (paper -0.0006).
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the Stata perfect-prediction and robust variance behavior against a Stata 15 run.

findings.description: Figures 1–3 use the Stata marhis package, which is unavailable in the R environment; the figures were approximated from the article’s stated method.
findings.evidence: R average predicted probability endpoints differ from narrative approximations, notably sugar contribution high-end prediction.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the exact marhis algorithm or run the original package in Stata.

limitations: No Stata installation was available; all reported computations use a direct R translation.
The supplied code does not calculate Table 2 contribution-change percentages.
Appendix Table A2 is referenced by the README but not reproduced in the shipped do-file; its numerical entries cannot be checked.
Appendix Table A1 summary statistics and full numerical data claims in the article are not all generated by the shipped analysis script.
The benchmark scope excludes publication of original code and data; local inputs remain at the supplied package path.
